metadata.method: Canonical createBattle/previewCard/playCard/endTurn are loaded from game source via Vite SSR. Each themed 18-card deck replaces a matching number of cards from startingDeck. Pairs differ only in the tested themed cards and, for artifact cases, the single named artifact. Same seed and encounter are used per pair. Results measure a scripted bot’s use of the deck and do not represent human play.
